framework.name: @birdapi/velinstyle
framework.tagline: VelinStyle is a CSS framework with WCAG 2.2 AAA-oriented defaults, native JavaScript runtime, and Web Components.
framework.pipeline: Core Foundation → Design System → Knowledge Graph → Prompt Engine → Review Engine → AI Metadata

breaking: Canonical tags: velin-tooltip, velin-stepper (legacy *-wc aliases deprecated).
.velin-mb-* is margin-bottom only; use .velin-my-* for block axis.
migration: Replace velin-tooltip-wc / velin-stepper-wc with velin-tooltip / velin-stepper.
Point AI tools at velin-agent.json or docs/llms.txt for framework context.
Prefer velinstyle scaffold / plan for page generation (plan → render → review).

components.purpose: Primary interactive control for actions and form submit.

seo.notes: CTA copy affects conversion, not crawl structure

spacingRules: pair with gap-3 or gap-4 in CTA groups
animationRules: no infinite pulse on primary CTA
designIntelligence.eyeFlow: place primary CTA after supporting copy

components.purpose: Grouped content surface for features, services, pricing tiers.

accessibility.notes: Heading inside card; don't nest interactive without care

commonMistakes: uneven card heights with sparse content
bestPractices: equal structure: icon, title, text, optional link

components.purpose: Text entry fields with labels for forms.

accessibility.notes: Visible label required; wire aria-invalid via form-summary
Landmark nav; skip link on pages

components.purpose: Blocking dialog overlay for focused tasks.

seo.notes: Do not put primary SEO content only in modal

compositionRules: use for confirm/prompt; modal for richer layouts

components.purpose: FAQ and progressive disclosure of related panels.

seo.notes: Keep question text in light DOM when possible

compositionRules: use in FAQ section after social proof

spacingRules: place before fields or at top of form

components.purpose: Progressive enhancement for sortable, filterable, paginated tables.
Documentation and site search against a JSON index.

commonMistakes: blocking main thread with huge index

accessibility.notes: Do not rely on color alone

components.purpose: Side panel overlay for navigation or secondary tasks without blocking the whole viewport like a modal.

compositionRules: prefer drawer for filters/nav; modal for blocking confirms

components.purpose: Bottom or edge sheet for mobile-first actions and pickers.

compositionRules: prefer sheet on small viewports for actions

components.purpose: Media-focused overlay for images and galleries.

seo.notes: Keep meaningful alt text in light DOM when possible

components.purpose: Transient status messages that do not block the page.

accessibility.notes: Prefer polite live region; do not replace form-summary

compositionRules: use for transient status; form errors use form-summary

velin-bottom-nav.keyboard: Native links or buttons in slot
velin-bottom-nav.notes: Host aria-label; slotchange syncs aria-current and infers item labels from data-nav/title.

velin-command.keyboard: Escape, arrows in results, Tab trap

velin-data-table.keyboard: Sort buttons; editable cells: Enter/F2 edit, Escape cancel; pagination
velin-data-table.notes: Enhances a light-DOM table. Optional editable attribute or data-editable cells for inline edit (velin-data-table-edit). No virtualization in v1.

velin-calendar.notes: Month calendar. value ISO date; velin-change event. Optional min/max.

velin-file-dropzone.notes: Client-side dropzone. Events velin-files / velin-error. Does not upload to a server.

velin-form-summary.keyboard: Summary links move focus to the offending field
velin-form-summary.notes: Disables native validation bubbles and renders a focusable role=alert summary. Sets aria-invalid and wires aria-describedby to per-field messages (WCAG 3.3.1, 3.3.3, 4.1.2). Field errors clear as soon as the field becomes valid.

velin-icon.notes: Decorative when no label; SVG aria-hidden. Do not set aria-hidden on host in JS.

velin-live-dot.notes: Status exposed via aria-label on host, not color alone.

velin-persist.notes: display:contents; auto-saves form field values (WCAG 3.3.7 Redundant Entry helper). Clears on form submit.

velin-popover.keyboard: Escape, Enter/Space on trigger; focus opens hover mode
velin-popover.notes: aria-labelledby or default aria-label; non-button triggers get role=button.

velin-sparkline.notes: Uses label, aria-label, or figcaption aria-labelledby.

velin-stepper.keyboard: N/A (display); pair with buttons calling next()/prev()
velin-stepper.notes: aria-label per step (completed/current/upcoming); sr-only Completed text; aria-current on active step.

conventions: Positioning: VelinStyle is a CSS framework with WCAG 2.2 AAA-oriented defaults, native JavaScript runtime, and Web Components — not a JS-only library or a utility-only CSS kit.
Use only velin-* utility classes and documented Web Components.
Prefer data-velin-theme on <html> for theme switching.
Run velinstyle scan on generated HTML before shipping.
Prefer registry-first skills (`velinstyle skills`) and workflow graphs (`velinstyle workflow`) before inventing custom pipelines.
Honor skill status, confidence, compatibility, and onlyIf predicates when automating.
Do not put secrets, API keys, or raw emails in velin-meta or page meta.
Resolve doc links against docs root (/docs/), not the current page folder.
